errors.evidence: The description omits the label for the horizontal axis, which is "Размер на компанията" (Company size).
The description uses the word "бало" (balloon) instead of "стълб" (bar) to describe the rectangular visual elements representing the data. A balloon is a completely different shape.
The description describes the color of the bars as "ярко син" (bright blue), whereas the image shows they are a light, sky-blue color.
